value.body: Most states have a tourism development corporation that runs hotels, resorts, guest houses, restaurants and tour services at tourist spots. They hire hotel-management graduates for front office, food and beverage, housekeeping, kitchen and unit-management roles.

items.label: Recruitment
items.note: Many posts are contract or fixed-term

items.label: Domestic tourist visits
items.note: Up from ~173 crore in 2022; counts visits, not unique people

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A BHM or hotel-management diploma; some posts need experience. Corporations advertise on their own or state government websites; selection is by written test, interview or walk-in, and some posts go through state recruitment boards.

value.title: At a glance
items: Openings are few and irregular, and many are on contract.
Units are often in remote or seasonal tourist locations.
Pay and promotion follow the corporation's own rules.
The central India Tourism Development Corporation (ITDC) also runs hotels and recruits separately.

value.title: Domestic tourist visits in India
value.note: 2021 was still affected by COVID-19 restrictions; 2023 is provisional. Visits are counted by states and UTs, so one person can be counted more than once.
value.source: Ministry of Tourism, India Tourism Statistics (as reported)
